newsitem.title: CHINA: August start for KAL Seoul-Dhaka cargo flights.
newsitem.headline: August start for KAL Seoul-Dhaka cargo flights.

text.p: Korean Airlines (KAL) will launch a weekly freighter service between Seoul and the Bangladesh capital of Dhaka on August 19, cargo vice president and general manager, Ji Young Lee said.
The service is a joint operation with Biman Banglasdesh Airlines using a KAL Airbus Industrie A300 freighter, Lee told Reuters in a telephone interview from Seoul.
Lee added that the planned end-July delivery of KAL's second Boeing 747-400 freighter will boost the carrier's service to its main cargo market, the U.S.
The new aircraft will begin flying between Seoul and U.S. East coast cargo destinations including New York, Boston and Chicago.
August will also see the airline's third McDonnell Douglas MD-11 freighter begin operating between Seoul and US West coast cargo destinations including include Los Angeles and Portland.

Plans to double KAL's freighter service between Seoul and Atlanta to twice weekly later this year, announced earlier in 1997, were also confirmed by Lee. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
